build.body: Next, add a page or a chat to your app, or ask FlowPilot to add steps for you.
build.title: You built and ran a flow.

finished.toUse: Take the bots and apps tour

use.body: You gave a bot a job and found an app. Curious how apps are made?
use.title: You're set.

addEvent.body: Every flow starts with an event: the moment it runs. Pick Event in the palette. On a touch screen, press and hold.
addEvent.title: Right-click the board and add an Event.

connect.body: The palette opens with only the nodes that fit. Pick one, for example Log. It gets wired for you.
connect.title: Drag from the event's white pin into empty space.

createApp.body: Any name works. You can change it later.
createApp.title: Name it, then create it.

createFlow.body: It opens a short form for the flow's name.
createFlow.title: Create the flow.

library.body: Apps hold your flows, data, pages and chats.
library.title: Open My Apps.

logs.body: Logs show what each node did, step by step. Open them any time from the board's side rail.
logs.title: That was your first run.

newApp.body: You'll build a small one in a few minutes.
newApp.title: Create a new app.

newFlow.body: A flow is the logic: nodes that do the work. Click New flow.
newFlow.title: Add the app's first flow.

openFlow.body: The board is where you build. Click your new flow.
openFlow.title: Open the flow.

run.body: That runs your flow once, right here on the board.
run.title: Press play on the event.

wait.body: Each node lights up while it works.
wait.title: Watch it run.

app.body: Add it and it shows up in My Apps, ready to use. No building needed.
app.title: Open an app that looks useful.

approve.body: Bots ask before they use your location, send messages or spend money. Allow it once, always, or say no.
approve.title: It's asking first. Answer the request.

bots.body: Bots are helpers that do tasks for you. They have their own tab.
bots.title: Click Bots in the sidebar.

crew.body: Assistant helps with anything, Flux builds flows with you. The chat opens next to your crew.
crew.title: Pick a bot from your crew.

details.body: It opens the details: what the bot can do and what it has to ask you about.
details.title: Click the bot's name above the chat.

explore.body: Explore has ready-made apps from Flow-Like and the community.
explore.title: Now apps: open Explore.

send.body: Ask for something real, like “What can you do for me?” or “Plan a three-day trip to Lisbon.”
send.title: Send it a message.

watch.body: Each step shows up as it happens. If it needs something sensitive, it asks you first.
watch.title: Watch it work.

welcome.body: We'll walk you through the parts you'll actually use, right in the app. It takes about two minutes and you can stop any time.

build.body: Make apps and automations on the board. Turns on developer mode.
build.title: Build my own

welcome.invite: Joined through an invite? Your team's apps are already in My Apps.
welcome.title: What brings you here?

use.body: Hand tasks to bots and use ready-made apps. No building.
use.title: Get things done
